verses.translation: Adam, Seth, Enos,

translations.ron: Adam, Set, Enos;
translations.grk: ἈΔΑΜ, Σὴθ, Ἐνὼς,

verses.translation: and Cainan, Maleleel, Jared,

translations.ron: Chenan, Mahalaleel, Iared;
translations.grk: καὶ Καϊνᾶν, Μαλελεὴλ, Ἰάρεδ,

verses.translation: Enoch, Mathusala, Lamech,

translations.ron: Enoh, Matusalem, Lameh;
translations.grk: Ἐνὼχ, Μαθουσάλα, Λάμεχ,

verses.translation: Noe: the sons of Noe, Sem, Cham, Japheth.

translations.ron: Noe, Sem, Ham şi Iafet.
translations.grk: Νῶε· υἱοὶ Νῶε, Σὴμ, Χὰμ, Ἰάφεθ.

verses.translation: The sons of Japheth, Gamer, Magog, Madaim, Jovan, Helisa, Thobel, Mosoch, and Thiras.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Iafet: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Iavan, Elişa, Tubal, Meşec şi Tiras.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἰάφεθ, Γαμὲρ, Μαγὼγ, Μαδαῒμ, Ἰωϋὰν, Ἑλισὰ, Θοβὲλ, Μοσὸχ, καὶ Θίρας.

verses.translation: And the sons of Gamer, Aschanaz, and Riphath, and Thorgama.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Gomer: Aşchenaz, Rifat şi Togarma.
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γαμὲρ, Ἀσχανὰζ, καὶ Ῥιφὰθ, καὶ Θοργαμά.

verses.translation: And the sons of Jovan, Helisa, and Tharsis, the Citians, and Rhodians.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Iavan: Elişa, Tarşiş, Chitim şi Dodanim.
translations.grk: Καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰωϋὰν, Ἑλισὰ, καὶ Θαρσὶς, Κίτιοι, καὶ Ῥόδιοι.

verses.translation: And the sons of Cham, Chus, and Mesraim, Phud and Chanaan.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ham: Cuş, Miţraim, Put şi Canaan.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Χὰμ, Χοὺς, καὶ Μεσραῒμ, Φοὺδ, καὶ Χαναάν.

verses.translation: And the sons of Chus, Saba, and Evila, and Sabatha, and Regma, and Sebethaca: and the sons of Regma, Saba, and Dadan.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Cuş: Seba, Havila, Savta Rama şi Sabteca. Fiii lui Rama: Şeba şi Dedan.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Χοὺς, Σαβὰ, καὶ Εὐιλὰ, καὶ Σαβαθὰ, καὶ Ῥεγμὰ, καὶ Σεβεθαχά· καὶ υἱοὶ Ῥεγμὰ, Σαβὰ, καὶ Δαδάν.

verses.translation: And Chus begot Nebrod: he began to be a mighty hunter on the earth.

translations.ron: Lui Cuş i s-a mai născut de asemenea şi Nimrod. Acesta a început să fie puternic pe pământ.
translations.grk: Καὶ Χοὺς ἐγέννησε τὸν Νεβρώδ· οὗτος ἤρξατο εἶναι γίγας κυνηγὸς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

verses.translation: The sons of Sem, Ælam, and Assur,

translations.ron: Fiii lui Sem: Elam, Asur, Arpaxad, Lud şi Aram. Fiii lui Aram: Ut, Hul, Gheter şi Meşec.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Σὴμ, Αἰλὰμ, καὶ Ἀσσοὺρ,

verses.translation: and Arphaxad, Sala,

translations.ron: Iar fiii lui Sim sunt: Arpaxad, Cainan, Selah,
translations.grk: καὶ Ἀρφαξὰδ, Σάλα,

verses.translation: Eber, Pheleg, Ragan,

translations.ron: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
translations.grk: Ἔβερ, Φαλὲγ, Ῥαγὰν,

verses.translation: Seruch, Nachor, Tharrha,

translations.ron: Serug, Nahor, Terah
translations.grk: Σεροὺχ, Ναχὼρ, Θάῤῥα,

verses.translation: Abraam.

translations.ron: Şi Avram, adică Avraam.
translations.grk: Ἁβραάμ·

verses.translation: And the sons of Abraam, Isaac, and Ismael.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Avraam sunt Isaac şi Ismael.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ δὲ Ἁβραὰμ, Ἰσαὰκ, καὶ Ἰσμαήλ.

verses.translation: And these are their generations: the first-born of Ismael, Nabæoth, and Kedar, Nabdeel, Massam,

translations.ron: Iată spiţa neamului lor: Nebaiot, întâiul născut al lui Ismael, apoi: Chedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
translations.grk: Αὗται δὲ αἱ γενέσεις αὐτῶν· πρωτότοκος Ἰσμαὴλ, Ναβαιὼθ, καὶ Κηδὰρ, Ναβδεὴλ, Μασσὰμ,

verses.translation: Masma, Iduma, Masse, Chondan, Thæman,

translations.ron: Mişma, Duma, Maşa, Hadad, Tema,
translations.grk: Μασμὰ, Ἰδουμὰ, Μασσὴ, Χονδὰν, Θαιμὰν,

verses.translation: Jettur, Naphes, Kedma: these are the sons of Ismael.

translations.ron: Ietur, Nafiş şi Chedma. Aceştia sunt fiii lui Ismael.
translations.grk: Ἰεττοὺρ, Ναφὲς, Κεδμά· οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ἰσμαήλ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Chettura Abraam's concubine:—and she bore him Zembram, Jexan, Madiam, Madam, Sobac, Soe: and the sons of Jexan; Dædan, and Sabai;

translations.ron: Fiii Cheturei, ţiitoarea lui Avraam. Ea a născut pe Zimran, Iocşan, Medan, Madian, Işbac şi Şuah. Fiii lui Iocşan sunt: Şeba şi Dedan. Fiii lui Dedan sunt: Raguel, Navdeel, Aşurim, Letuşim şi Leumim.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Χεττούρας παλλακῆς Ἁβραάμ· καὶ ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ τὸν Ζεμβρὰμ, Ἰεξὰν, Μαδιὰμ, Μαδὰμ, Σοβὰκ, Σωέ· καὶ υἱοὶ Ἰεξὰν, Δαιδὰν, καὶ Σαβαΐ.

verses.translation: and the sons of Madiam; Gephar, and Opher, and Enoch, and Abida, and Eldada; all these were the sons of Chettura.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Madian sunt: Efa, Efer, Enoh, Abida şi Eldaa. Toţi aceştia sunt fiii Cheturei.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Μαδιὰμ, Γεφὰρ, καὶ Ὀφὲρ, καὶ Ἐνὼχ, καὶ Ἀβιδὰ, καὶ Ἐλδαδά· πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Χεττούρας.

verses.translation: And Abraam begot Isaac: and the sons of Isaac were Jacob, and Esau.

translations.ron: Lui Avraam i s-a născut Isaac. Fiii lui Isaac sunt: Isav şi Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγέννησεν Ἁβραὰμ τὸν Ἰσαάκ· καὶ υἱοὶ Ἰσαὰκ, Ἰακὼβ, καὶ Ἡσαῦ.

verses.translation: The sons of Esau, Eliphaz, and Raguel, and Jeul, and Jeglom, and Core.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Isav sunt: Elifaz, Raguel, Ieuş, Ialam şi Core.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἡσαῦ, Ἐλιφὰζ, καὶ Ῥαγουὴλ, καὶ Ἰεοὺλ, καὶ Ἰεγλὸμ, καὶ Κορέ.

verses.translation: The sons of Eliphaz: Thæman, and Omar, Sophar, and Goötham, and Kenez, and Thamna, and Amalec.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Elifaz sunt: Teman, Omar, Ţefi, Gatam, Chenaz; iar Temna, concubina lui Elifaz, i-a născut pe Amalec.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Ἐλιφὰζ, Θαιμὰν, καὶ Ὠμὰρ, Σωφὰρ, καὶ Γοωθὰμ, καὶ Κενὲζ, καὶ Θαμνὰ, καὶ Ἀμαλήκ.

verses.translation: And the sons of Raguel, Naches, Zare, Some, and Moze.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Raguel sunt: Nahat, Zerah, Şama şi Miza.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ῥαγουὴλ, Ναχὲς, Ζαρὲ, Σομὲ, καὶ Μοζέ.

verses.translation: The sons of Seir, Lotan, Sobal, Sebegon, Ana, Deson, Osar, and Disan.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Seir sunt: Lotan, Şobal, Ţibeon, Ana, Dişon, Eţer şi Dişan.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Σηῒρ, Λωτὰν, Σωβὰλ, Σεβεγὼν, Ἀνὰ, Δησὼν, Ὠσὰρ, καὶ Δισάν.

verses.translation: And the sons of Lotan, Chorri, and Æman; and the sister of Lotan was Thamna.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Lotan sunt: Hori şi Heman; iar sora lui Lotan se numea Timna.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Λωτὰν, Χοῤῥὶ, καὶ Αἰμὰν· ἀδελφὴ δὲ Λωτὰν Θαμνά. Υἱοὶ Σωβὰλ, Ἀλὼν, Μαχανὰθ, Ταιβὴλ, Σωφὶ, καὶ Ὠνὰν·

verses.translation: The sons of Sobal; Alon, Machanath, Tæbel, Sophi, and Onan: and the sons of Sebegon; Æth, and Sonan.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Şobal sunt: Alvan, Manahat, Ebal, Şefo şi Onam. Fiii lui Ţibeon sunt: Aia şi Ana.
translations.grk: υἱοὶ δὲ Σεβεγὼν, Ἀῒθ, καὶ Σωνάν.

verses.translation: The sons of Sonan, Dæson: and the sons of Dæson; Emeron, and Asebon, and Jethram, and Charran.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Ana sunt: Dişon şi Olibama; fiii lui Dişon sunt: Hemdan, Eşban, Itran şi Cheran.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ Σωνὰν. Δαισών· υἱοὶ δὲ Δαισὼν, Ἐμερὼν, καὶ Ἀσεβὼν, καὶ Ἰεθρὰμ, καὶ Χαῤῥάν.

verses.translation: And the sons of Hosar, Balaam, and Zucam, and Acan: the sons of Disan, Os, and Aran.

translations.ron: Fiii lui Eţer sunt: Bilhan, Zaavan şi Acan; fiii lui Dişan sunt: Uţ şi Aran.
translations.grk: Καὶ υἱοὶ Ὡσὰρ, Βαλαὰμ, καὶ Ζουκὰμ, καὶ Ἀκάν· υἱοὶ Δισὰν, Ὢς καὶ Ἀράν.

verses.translation: And these are their kings, Balac the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dennaba.

translations.ron: Aceştia sunt regii care au domnit în pământul Edom, înainte de a se ridica rege, peste fiii lui Israel, Bela, fiul lui Beor, cetatea căruia se numea Dinhaba.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὗτοι οἱ βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν· Βαλὰκ υἱὸς Βεὼρ, καὶ ὄνομα τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ Δενναβά.

verses.translation: And Balac died, and Jobab the son of Zara of Bosorrha reigned in his stead.

translations.ron: Murind Bela, după el a fost făcut rege Iobab, fiul lui Zerah din Boţra.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέθανε Βαλὰκ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Ἰωβὰβ υἱὸς Ζαρὰ ἐκ Βοσόῤῥας.

verses.translation: And Jobab died, and Asom of the land of the Thæmanites reigned in his stead.

translations.ron: După moartea lui Iobab s-a făcut rege Huşam, în ţara Temaniţilor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ἰωβὰβ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Ἁσὸμ ἐκ γῆς Θαιμανών.

verses.translation: And Asom died, and Adad the son of Barad reigned in his stead, who smote Madiam in the plain of Moab: and the name of his city was Gethaim.

translations.ron: Murind Huşam, s-a făcut rege după el Hadad, fiul lui Bedad, care a lovit pe Madianiţi în câmpia Moabului. Oraşul lui se numea Avit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ἁσόμ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Ἀδὰδ υἱὸς Βαρὰδ, ὁ πατάξας Μαδιὰμ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ Μωὰβ· καὶ ὄνομα τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ Γεθαίμ.

verses.translation: And Adad died, and Sebla of Masecca reigned in his stead.

translations.ron: Murind Hadad, s-a făcut rege după el Şamla, din Masreca;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ἁδὰδ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Σεβλὰ ἐκ Μασεκκάς.

verses.translation: And Sebla died, and Saul of Rhoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

translations.ron: Murind Şamla, s-a făcut rege după el Şaul, din Rehobotul cel de lângă râu.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέθανε Σεβλὰ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Σαοὺλ ἐκ Ῥωβὼθ τῆς παρὰ ποταμόν.

verses.translation: And Saul died, and Balaennor son of Achobor reigned in his stead.

translations.ron: Murind Şaul, s-a făcut rege după el Baal-Hanan, fiul lui Acbor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέθανε Σαοὺλ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Βαλαεννὼρ υἱὸς Ἀχωβώρ.

verses.translation: And Balaennor died, and Adad son of Barad reigned in his stead; and the name of his city was Phogor.

translations.ron: Murind Baal-Hanan, s-a făcut rege după el Hadad. Numele cetăţii lui era Pau, iar numele femeii lui era Mehetabeel, fiica lui Matred, fiica lui Mezahab.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέθανε Βαλαεννὼρ, καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντʼ αὐτοῦ Ἀδὰδ υἱὸς Βαρὰδ, καὶ ὄνομα τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ, Φογώρ.

verses.translation: The princes of Edom: prince Thamna, prince Golada, prince Jether,

translations.ron: Murind Hadad, au urmat căpetenii peste Edom: căpetenia Timna, căpetenia Alia, căpetenia Ietet,
translations.grk: Ἡγεμόνες Ἐδώμ· ἡγεμὼν Θαμνὰ, ἡγεμὼν Γωλαδὰ, ἡγεμὼν Ἰεθὲρ,

verses.translation: prince Elibamas, prince Elas, prince Phinon,

translations.ron: Căpetenia Oholibama, căpetenia Ela, căpetenia Pinon,
translations.grk: ἡγεμὼν Ἐλιβαμὰς, ἡγεμὼν Ἠλὰς, ἡγεμὼν Φινὼν,

verses.translation: prince Kenez, prince Thæman, prince Babsar, prince Magediel,

translations.ron: Căpetenia Chenaz, căpetenia Teman, căpetenia Mibţar,
translations.grk: ἡγεμὼν Κενέζ, ἡγεμὼν Θαιμὰν, ἡγεμὼν Βαβσὰρ,

verses.translation: prince Zaphoin. These are the princes of Edom.

translations.ron: Căpetenia Magdiel, căpetenia Iram. Acestea sunt căpeteniile Edomului.
translations.grk: ἡγεμὼν Μαγεδιὴλ, ἡγεμὼν Ζαφωΐν· οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Ἐδώμ.
